scripts.builder: npm run kill-ports && npm run agent:auth && npm run agent:launch
scripts.docker:status: docker-compose ps && echo '\n--- Docker Disk Usage ---' && docker system df
scripts.docker:health: docker-compose exec -T backend curl -s http://localhost:8000/actuator/health | jq . || echo 'Health check failed'
scripts.docker:rebuild: docker-compose down && docker-compose build --no-cache && docker-compose up -d
scripts.docker:clean:containers: docker-compose down --remove-orphans && echo 'Stopped and removed all containers'
scripts.docker:clean:images: docker rmi $(docker images -q indicab-*) 2>/dev/null || echo 'No indicab images to remove'
scripts.docker:clean:volumes: docker volume prune -f && echo 'Cleaned unused volumes'
scripts.docker:clean:cache: docker builder prune -f && echo 'Cleaned build cache'
scripts.docker:clean:all: npm run docker:clean:containers && npm run docker:clean:images && npm run docker:clean:volumes && npm run docker:clean:cache && echo '✅ DOCKER CLEANUP COMPLETE: Volumes, images, caches, and containers cleaned'
scripts.docker:reset: npm run kill-ports && npm run docker:clean:all && docker system prune -f && echo '✅ DOCKER SYSTEM RESET: Ready for fresh start'
scripts.docker:emergency: npm run kill-ports && npm run docker:clean:all && rm -rf indicab-frontend/node_modules indicab-backend/target 2>/dev/null; docker-compose down -v && docker system prune -af && echo '🚨 EMERGENCY DOCKER RESET: All containers, volumes, images, and caches cleaned. Fresh rebuild ready.'
scripts.docker:up: docker-compose up -d && npm run docker:health && docker-compose ps
scripts.docker:down:full: docker-compose down -v && echo 'Stopped all services and removed volumes'
scripts.docker:inspect: docker-compose config && echo '\n--- Image Layers ---' && docker-compose images
scripts.docker:network: docker network inspect indicab-website_default 2>/dev/null || docker network ls | grep indicab
scripts.docker:database:backup: docker-compose exec -T mysql mysqldump -u root -p indicab_website > backup_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql && echo 'Database backed up'
scripts.docker:database:check: docker-compose exec -T mysql mysql -u root -p -e 'SELECT VERSION(); SHOW TABLES FROM indicab_website;'
scripts.docker:prune:aggressive: docker system prune -af --volumes && echo '✅ AGGRESSIVE CLEANUP: Removed ALL unused containers, images, volumes, and networks'
scripts.docker:diagnose: echo '=== DOCKER DIAGNOSIS ===' && docker --version && docker-compose --version && docker-compose config --quiet && docker-compose ps && docker system df && echo '=== END DIAGNOSIS ==='
scripts.docker:validate: docker-compose config --quiet && echo '✅ Docker Compose configuration is valid' || echo '❌ Docker Compose configuration is invalid'
scripts.docker:backup-full: mkdir -p .backups && docker-compose exec -T mysql mysqldump -u root -p --all-databases > .backups/full_backup_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).sql && echo '✅ Full database backup created in .backups/'
scripts.docker:restore: if [ -f "$1" ]; then docker-compose exec -T mysql mysql -u root -p < $1 && echo '✅ Database restored'; else echo '❌ Backup file not found'; fi
scripts.docker:fix-permissions: docker-compose exec -T mysql mysql -u root -p -e 'ALTER USER root@localhost IDENTIFIED BY "root"; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;' && echo '✅ MySQL permissions fixed'
